title: 2026 Global Loneliness Awareness Week Summit
discussion_signal: The post frames connection, belonging, loneliness, and social prescribing as a public-health and community agenda. It adds a civic-discussion layer to the CDC distinction between reported support and actual participation: public attention to connection is itself an institutional response, not proof that isolation has fallen.
linked_research_question: When people report support, how does that translate—or fail to translate—into participation, belonging, and reduced loneliness?
limits: The post is an event reflection rather than a prevalence estimate
Self-selected professional discussion is not representative public opinion
Attention to loneliness does not establish improved social participation
